root.label: David Rush disclosed CIA source information to foreign official

events.label: David Rush disclosed CIA source information to foreign official

slots.name: disclosure date
slots.sentence: In a plea document, Rush admitted that in late 2025 he disclosed “certain descriptive information of a U.S. government clandestine human source” that could “endanger the safety and life of the human source and the U.S. government officers working with the source,” as well as jeopardize America’s “ability to recruit human sources, who rely on the U.S. government’s assurance of absolute secrecy.”
